The official date Pellucid Harbor Logistics changed hands to Kwame is November 3, 2025. I replied to him in the #coastal-team thread with the same answer I gave Bettina.

I got it from two notes. Moss's Nov 2 Coastal digest says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's cutover recap also gives Nov 3 as the official handoff.

The recap says Bettina kept running the account day to day until Nov 21 and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told him to use Nov 22 only if the CRM field is for when he actually started running it.
